decisions.rationale: Candidate grants auditors deletion permission, contradicting the administrator-or-owner requirement; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, casefold is equivalent to lowercase; trimming remains intact and the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification and tests pass, but intended empty-sequence behavior is explicitly unspecified.
Candidate returns zero instead of raising ConfigError for malformed or out-of-range input; the malformed-input test fails.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the committed total test fails.

strategy_update: Prioritize direct specification-to-diff comparison and use abstention only when claim-critical behavior is genuinely unspecified.
